interpretive_fragments.literal_fragment: V NEDELI RANO PRIMO DO PUDEJOVIC RYCHLI?EM,
interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [V neděli ráno přímo do Budějovic rychlíkem?; literal PUDEJOVIC needs editorial P → B; ? → K and CH provisional.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [On Sunday morning directly to Budějovice by express train?; literal PUDEJOVIC needs editorial P → B, ? → K and provisional CH. Place identification remains editorial.]

interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [O půl jedenácté. Prosím, by…?; literal PY needs editorial P → B.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [At half past ten. Please, that…?; literal PY needs editorial P → B.]

interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [Restante; fragment, not a completed postal instruction.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [Restante; fragment, not a completed postal instruction.]

interpretive_fragments.literal_fragment: TISIC VRELYCH PUS POSILA TI TVUJ, VECNE
interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [Tisíc vřelých pus posílá ti tvůj, věčně…; CH provisional.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [A thousand warm kisses are sent to you by yours, forever…; provisional CH.]

interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [Promluviti…; the following verb is left unresolved.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [To talk…; the following verb is left unresolved.]

interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [Se svým srdéčkem o samotě?; SRDEC?EM requires q → K; separate fragment.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [With my sweetheart in private?; SRDEC?EM requires q → K; separate fragment.]
